description: Assembly source code implementing context switch and thread entry wrapper functions for the SPARC architecture in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: z_sparc_context_switch
methods.description: Performs context switching between threads, saving and restoring register states, managing window overflow, and updating thread switch handle.

methods.name: z_thread_entry_wrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function that sets up thread entry parameters and calls the thread entry function.
